hooks.name: Confirm pushes to main and tag pushes

action.command: python3 -c "import json,sys,re;c=json.load(sys.stdin).get('tool_input',{}).get('command','');hit=re.search(r'git\\s+push\\b.*(\\bmain\\b|\\bmaster\\b|\\bv\\d+\\.\\d+\\.\\d+|--tags)',c);print(json.dumps({'hookSpecificOutput':{'permissionDecision':'ask','permissionDecisionReason':'This push targets main or a release tag (tags publish a release). Confirm.'}})) if hit else None"
